courses.title: KP HUBE Complete YouTube Course
courses.subtitle: Channel Growth, Monetization, Viral Titles, Thumbnails & Pro YouTube Tricks
courses.description: KP HUBE ka Complete YouTube Mastery Course — isme aap seekhenge apna YouTube channel kaise grow karein, channel monetize kaise karein, high-CTR viral titles aur clickable thumbnails kaise banayein, aur fastest growth ke liye secret YouTube tricks & tips.
learningObjectives: Apna YouTube Channel 0 se tezi se kaise Grow karein
Channel Monetize karne ke sabhi steps (1000 Subs, 4000 Hrs & AdSense)
High-CTR Viral Titles likhne aur SEO rank karne ka tarika
Clickable Thumbnails design karna jo views double karein
Secret YouTube Tricks & Tips jo bade creators use karte hain

lessons.title: 01. Apna YouTube Channel Kaise Grow Karein
lessons.description: YouTube Algorithm kaise kaam karta hai, sahi niche select karna, aur 0 se tezi se subscribers aur views badhane ki complete strategy.

lessons.title: 02. Viral Title Kaise Likhein (High-CTR & SEO)
lessons.description: Aise clickable aur searchable YouTube titles banana jo search me rank karein aur browse feature me logon ko click karne par majboor karein.

lessons.title: 03. Clickable YouTube Thumbnail Design Masterclass
lessons.description: High-CTR thumbnail psychology, color contrast, clean text aur mobile screen par stand-out karne wale thumbnails banana seekhein.

lessons.title: 04. Apna YouTube Channel Kaise Monetize Karein
lessons.description: 1000 Subscribers, 4000 Watch Hours / 10M Shorts views criteria, AdSense approval, copyright rules aur YouTube se earning ke sabhi tarike.

lessons.title: 05. Pro YouTube Tricks & Tips (Fast Growth Secrets)
lessons.description: Upload timing, YouTube Studio analytics, Shorts-to-Long audience funnel aur video viral karne ki practical YouTube tricks & tips.
